cards.name: TMB VIBE360 Credit Card

cards.evidence: Issuer page: Term-Deposit-backed card, free joining, zero annual fee, limit Rs 20,000 to Rs 5,00,000 (the page eligibility text still says 'TMB VIBE360' - a copy slip on the issuer's page).

cards.name: TMB Platinum Credit Card
